notes:
Key account — long tail catalog marketplace (apparel + home goods). Big driver: reduce search drop-off and cart abandonment during promotions. High-level asks: 
- Scale: ingest ~180M product vectors (including variants) with nightly incremental refresh window (2-3 hrs).
- Latency targets: p95 <= 120ms for embeddings retrieval, p99 <= 300ms end-to-end for user-facing rerank path.
- Cost sensitivity: target blended cost-per-query <= $0.0008 (embeddings + rerank compute averaged); CFO watching infra TCO closely.
- Reranking needs: candidate generation via ANN (dense + lexical hybrid), then cross-encoder rerank of top-30–50. Looking for Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and quantization to hit cost targets.
- Traffic profile: baseline QPS moderate but monthly spikes x6 during promos; strict need for graceful capacity scaling and predictable billing.
- Security: SSO (Okta/SAML), audit logs, KMS for keys, EU data residency for EU customers.
- Quote from Head of Search: "We can accept slightly higher recall for long tail if it keeps cost per query stable during Black Friday windows."
- Current stack: product catalog in BigQuery; existing vector store prototype on Pinecone (costed out). Interested in comparing Redwood Dedicated vs Pinecone + custom reranker.
- POC success metrics: ingest throughput, index build time, incremental refresh delta < 3 hours, average cost/query, p95 latency under 120ms, quality measured by NDCG on 5 eval sets.
- Risks: catalog ingestion disrupts nightly ETL; need migration runbook.
- Recent interactions: 2025-01-30 discovery call (ff-993), demo 2025-02-18 (ff-1012). Follow-up: send recommended POC outline + cost model, sample quantization profiles, and a draft SLA for peak events.
- Stubs/links: pricing deck (drive:/deals/shelffare/shelffare-pricing-v2.pdf), security FAQ (drive:/security/shelffare/security-faq-2025.pdf), Jira RINF-4123 opened for ingestion performance questions.
